export_evidence: No export shipment row found. The only customs rows retrieved are inbound to India, e.g. "2025-11-27 | PALADIN PAINTS & CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED | BERGER PAINTS (S) PTE LTD | PEPOX 2929-X-65 (Epoxy Resin Solution) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | Jurong, SINGAPORE | 39073090 | BOL 4523735" — supplier is the foreign party, buyer is Paladin, i.e. an IMPORT, not an export. Source: importkey.com/countries/india/paladin-paints-chemicals-private-limited, page counter states "Total Shipments 254 Records detected", "Trading Partners 4", "Ports 7", "Latest Cargo 2025-11-27"; only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view (counter 254 vs 5 rows seen). No outbound/destination-foreign row appeared in any of the 5 rows seen, so export activity is unverified rather than disproven.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, or contract record was retrieved — all registry and tender sources returned HTTP 403 or JS challenges (zaubacorp 403, eximpedia 403, trademo 403, importgenius JS challenge, seair 404). The only India-side trace is the registered address in the customs header: "PALADIN PAINTS & CHEMICALS PRIVATE LIMITED PLOT NO.43 , KUMBHIVALI ,SAVROLI KHARPADA ROAD" (Raigad, Maharashtra) — an address is not a supply record. Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not confirmed.
note: Direction of trade is the key finding: every retrievable customs row is an IMPORT into India (Nhava Sheva Sea / Sahar Air) from Berger Paints Singapore, Kanat Boyacilik (Turkey), Elementum Specialities (New Zealand) and Kusumoto Chemicals (Shanghai). The ImportKey page title says 'Import Customs Data Records', and the second slug variant (paladin-paints-and-chemicals-pvt-ltd) showed 5 inbound rows dated 2016-03-25 to 2022-05-15 with B/Ls BOM20B111C00, BOM203444100, BOM303928700, BOM903959100, BOM603444100, HS 280160, all 'Nhava Sheva, India' as origin. So the company is demonstrably an active chemical importer/distributor (epoxy hardeners, phenalkamines) — but that is inbound logistics, not evidence of export shipments or of domestic supply. No export B/L with a foreign destination was found, and no GST/tender/contract evidence of domestic sales was obtainable. Per Rule 5: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено; внутренние поставки — заявлено, не подтверждено. Note the declared HS codes (292129; 382499; 390720) are broadly consistent with the observed cargo (29212990, 39073090), but the observed codes are import-side, so they do not validate an export HS profile. Caveat on data quality: the ImportKey 'Buyers' block mixes this company into multi-company counterparty lists (e.g. 'CC GRAN LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY', 'EFORKIM KIMYA', 'NEO CHEMICAL LLC'), so those counterparty counts are unreliable and were not used as evidence. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unreachable for the whole session, so no independent corroboration was possible; volza, eximpedia, trademo and importgenius free views were all blocked. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached, not estimated. No CIN/PAN retrieved; not invented.
